work.wait.title: Waiting on you
work.wait.questionBelow: It asked you a question: answer it in the box below.
work.wait.questionTop: It asked you a question: read it and answer it at the top.
work.wait.intake: Its intake asked you; the answer is on its ask.
work.wait.name.question: its question
work.wait.rule.title: Rules it proposed
work.wait.rule.lead: It proposed a change to what agents may do. Nothing changes until you allow it.
work.wait.rule.tells: Once it is allowed, this session is told so and goes on.
work.wait.rule.unheard: It takes no words now, so it is not told; a session started from now on is handed the rule.
work.wait.rule.said: The rule you proposed is allowed now: {{change}}. Go on with what you needed it for.
work.wait.rule.told: Session {{session}} is told the rule is allowed, and goes on.
work.wait.rule.notHeard: Session {{session}} takes no words now, so it is not told; a session started from now on is handed the rule.
work.wait.rule.untold: Allowed, and session {{session}} did not take the words: tell it yourself to go on.
work.wait.helper.lead: It asked for another agent’s help. Nothing is asked until you let it.
